web_ui_headline: Record your screen. Shape the story.
web_ui_intro: Capture, edit and export product demos locally with Guerilla Glass.
web_ui_build_note: In development. No packaged download is available yet.
web_ui_preview_alt: Current macOS editor showing an editable browser recording with scene thumbnails and camera settings.
web_ui_preview_caption: The current macOS development build, with an editable browser recording.
web_ui_workflow_title: One local project, through to export
web_ui_record_body: Choose a display or window on macOS. Capture the source on your machine.
web_ui_edit_body: Cut and reorder scenes on the timeline. Adjust framing and inspect agent-authored edit plans.
web_ui_deliver_body: Keep the editable project and export a video file. Local work does not require a hosted account.
web_ui_open_body: The desktop app is in active development. You can build it from source, inspect the code and report issues. Hosted review and paid team plans are not available.
web_ui_faq_platform_a: The native recording and export path targets macOS 13 and later. Windows and Linux engines are experimental foundations, not equivalent recording apps.
web_ui_faq_start_q: How do I get the app?
web_ui_faq_start_a: There is no packaged release yet. The setup guide explains prerequisites and how to build and run the macOS app from source.
web_ui_faq_account_a: Local capture, project editing and export do not require a hosted account. Cloud review and paid collaboration are not available yet.
web_ui_faq_permissions_a: macOS requires Screen Recording permission for capture. Audio and input-event features may also need Microphone and Input Monitoring permissions.
web_ui_faq_agent_q: Can an agent edit a recording?
web_ui_faq_agent_a: External agents can author edit plans for validation and application to a local project. The result stays editable. This workflow is under active development.
web_ui_footer_note: Built in the open. Recording stays local.
web_ui_about_title: A local editor for product demos
web_ui_about_body: Guerilla Glass is an open-source recorder and demo editor in development. The project focuses on a complete local workflow: recording a source, shaping it on a timeline and exporting a video. External edit plans let agents work on the same editable project.
web_ui_not_found_body: This page does not exist or has moved.
web_ui_error_body: Try loading the page again. The desktop app works independently of this website.
web_ui_meta_title: Guerilla Glass | Local screen recording and editing
web_ui_meta_description: An open-source macOS recorder and demo editor in development. Record, edit and export locally.

web_ui_demo_description: A browser recording of this FAQ, cut and reframed with an agent-authored plan, then exported by the macOS engine. Silent, 12 seconds. Pause to read either answer.
